description: This PHP source file defines the ServerRequestFactory class within the Laminas\Diactoros namespace. The class implements creation and marshaling of HTTP server request objects from PHP's superglobal variables ($_SERVER, $_GET, $_POST, etc.), providing utilities for constructing PSR-7 ServerRequest instances suitable for use in a PSR-15 middleware or server environment.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactory
classes.description: Implements PSR-17 ServerRequestFactoryInterface, providing methods to create ServerRequest instances from PHP superglobals and to marshal URI data based on server environment variables and headers.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates an HTTP PSR-7 ServerRequest instance based on PHP's superglobals ($_SERVER, $_GET, $_POST, etc.) and applies an optional request filter.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new ServerRequest object with specified HTTP method and URI, using supplied server parameters.
